response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s."healtheval" AS status, SUM(sc."scancount") AS total_scan_count, SUM(sc."gbsize") / NULLIF(SUM(sc."spanmin"), 0) AS rate FROM "scans" AS sc JOIN "sites" AS s ON sc."zoneref" = s."zoneregistry" GROUP BY s."healtheval"), rate_average AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT r.status, r.total_scan_count, r.rate, r.rate - a.average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM status_rates AS r CROSS JOIN rate_average AS a WHERE r.rate > a.average_rate

assumptions.assumption: A status with zero total duration has a missing rate.
